name: @3pt/battery-signals
description: Battery: kernel-witnessed signals from the box. bpftrace sensors (Cilium-style: declared, attached, JSON out) → a transform pipeline (normalize, enrich, redact, strip, sample, pushed plugins) → a durable SQLite WAL store → a drain into Atlas (signals time-series + measurements with source 'kernel'). Instrument turns those into findings; the improver turns findings into policy.
